assets.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. One perfectly regular 3-by-3 illustration atlas for a first-grade lesson about tools. Nine independent rectangular cells, equal width and height, perfectly straight thin cream gutters exactly at the thirds. Match warm cream, deep pine, teal, apricot and persimmon cut-paper silhouettes with matte gouache and a light paper grain. Original workshop props, no people or text, no letters, numerals, background clutter, decorative elements, extra tools or duplication. Generous margin in each tile, high contrast small silhouettes. Row 1 is a three-panel experiment, use EXACTLY the same tall rectangular sage-teal storage box and the same small orange soft fabric loop in all three independent tiles, both always the same size and color, seen from the same slightly elevated angle; front half of box walls is illustrated with a simple cutaway opening so the floor and loop are visible; no windows or glass. Row 1 left: loop alone lies flat deep in the back-right corner, tall walls around it, no tool. Row 1 middle: one short orange plastic child-safe blunt broad-pad tweezer tong reaches into the SAME box from the top left but its tip is visibly far ABOVE the loop, unable to touch it. Row 1 right: longer pine-green plastic tweezer tong, same broad apricot rounded pads, comes from top left, gently holds the orange soft loop and lifts it above the edge of the SAME teal box; clear contact, loop visibly hanging from the tips, inside box now empty. Row 2 left: one isolated child-safe pair of closed short scissors with two apricot finger rings, a visible pivot, rounded silver tips and one contiguous closed blade silhouette, no sharp point, no hands. Row 2 center: one isolated green rectangular strip of craft paper with a conspicuous clean straight slit from one edge, no scissors or printed guides. Row 2 right: single oversize gray practice screw with a clear recessed cross groove, fitted partway into a rounded pale blue panel, seen from a slightly elevated view, no screwdriver. Row 3 left: side profile of one little wooden workshop push cart, deep pine body, two separate visible round wheels, soft orange bumper, no cargo. Row 3 center: one isolated short orange child-safe tweezer tong, smooth rounded broad gripping pads visible, no scissors blades, no objects inside the jaws. Row 3 right: one isolated teal short-handled broad shallow scoop with its open top and curved leading lip clearly visible, usable to lift loose paper. No content crosses cells.
